authorisation: D74 (2026-10-26), continued under the same mission and PR #251 (Codex review findings on the head of T0252). It does NOT authorise merging PR #251, Go-Live, or any live network, routing, PMS or financial action by the agent.
findings: P1: p3_interface_can_authorise evaluated the feed predicate at now(), which makes the revision's max_auth_cache_age ceiling trivially true, so a disconnected candidate with an expired roster could return a trusted 'no such guest' and let another interface's guest in on a shared network. Fixed by migration 0156 (evidence time = the roster's age) and by applying the same ceiling to the health the console shows (ROSTER_EXPIRED), so the readiness assessment and the resolver agree.

P2: the rollback tool's shared-set count queried the policy table inside a CASE, which PostgreSQL resolves before evaluating, so a database without the table (never migrated, or rolled back) was reported as unreadable and a harmless rollback refused. The existence check is now a separate query.
